## Observations

- `coop` with Redis messaging only (no shared git) at 250 steps passed 8/10, the same score and the same two failures as `coop --git` at 250 steps (`8/10`), so shared git made no difference on `flash_10` at this budget. All 8 passing pairs merged cleanly (7 `clean` naive merges, plus `identical` patches on `typst_task/6554`, where the peers exchanged code over messages and submitted byte-identical patches). There were `0` merge conflicts even without git visibility, and peers sent 30 to 78 messages per passing pair.
- `pallets_jinja_task/1559`: both peers hit step 250 with nothing pushed after 25 and 33 compactions, sending only 3 messages in total. `pillow_task/290`: both peers submitted and the patches merged cleanly, but feature 4 failed 1 of its 8 tests while feature 5 passed all 9.
- At `-c 5` (10 agents) input load peaked at 1,151,034 tok/min, with 48 `429` retries and 2 `5xx` retries (`0` agent errors). This run is part of why we lowered concurrency to about 8 agents per key at 28K. Cost was `$23.05` vs. `$19.87` for `coop --git` at 250 steps.
